problem_and_intended_users_defined.rationale: The product defines the maintainer/beginner problem narrowly: safe, reproducible README Markdown style/structure checking without inventing another parser or silently editing documentation.

public_repository_or_distribution_surfac.rationale: P-047 is distributed publicly as a reusable GitHub composite Action and a non-draft v0.4.0 release.

explicit_open_source_license.rationale: The public proving-ground repository contains the MIT License covering the P-047 source.

complete_readme.rationale: The product-scoped public documentation covers purpose, usage, output semantics, architecture, security/privacy, recovery, accessibility, localization path, support and limitations.

beginner_start_here_path.rationale: A dedicated beginner path provides minimal least-privilege usage, PASS/FAIL interpretation, safety/privacy guidance, recovery and support.

engineering_or_architecture_documentatio.rationale: Architecture, upstream adoption, fixed profile, path/resource bounds, extension-point threat boundary, mutation policy, outputs, test strategy and limitations are explicit.

reproducible_installation_or_use_instruc.rationale: Consumers can invoke the released @v0.4.0 Action directly; its upstream markdownlint-cli2 Action is pinned to immutable commit 21c1be1b93ad9ed58fa840aacc3f279cde2a72ff and its fixed configuration ships with the Action.

safety_scope_and_limitations.rationale: The product explicitly limits PASS to fixed-profile README Markdown style/structure and excludes correctness, completeness, link health, accessibility conformance, security hygiene and DLP claims.

recovery_or_rollback_guidance_for_mutati.rationale: P-047 is non-mutating because auto-fix is hard-disabled. Recovery requires discarding incomplete evidence and rerunning unchanged source; Action rollback is a workflow pin/revert, not a content mutation.

tests_and_ci.rationale: Contract and hosted acceptance cover positive linting, actual lint failure, no README, traversal, symlink/resource boundaries, immutable upstream pin, no plugin surface, no auto-fix, byte immutability, governed release and two released-ref real-public-consumer executions.

security_and_privacy_review.rationale: The review covers fixed no-plugin configuration, traversal/symlink/resource refusal, least privilege, no auto-fix, README-content visibility, privacy-safe support intake and non-DLP truth boundaries.

accessibility_review.rationale: The non-graphical developer Action exposes textual PASS/FAIL, counts and stable rule identifiers without color/pointer dependence. This is an applicability review, not WCAG conformance or human assistive-technology acceptance.

multilingual_path_considered.rationale: Stable machine outputs/rule identifiers are language-neutral integration keys and explanatory documentation can be localized independently; v0.4.0 human documentation is English-first and multilingual acceptance is not claimed.

contribution_and_issue_paths.rationale: General contribution guidance and a dedicated privacy-safe P-047 support/reproduction path exist.

canonical_handover_or_build_record_updat.rationale: The final completion tranche binds product architecture, upstream identity, governed release, exact public tag source, two released-ref public consumers, retained evidence, limitations and portfolio-state promotion in one auditable record.
